Her husband doesn’t love her, her mother-in-law loathes her, her sister-in-law causes trouble, and netizens viciously insult her…

The sister-in-law followed Gu Nanyan around, full of admiration;
Her love rivals showered Gu Nanyan with gifts;

88239.synopsis:
Kwon Jungwoo kept being kind to me.
“Jungwoo, I think a lot of girls might misunderstand you.”
“I don’t act like this with girls. I do this because it’s you.”
“…Why?”
“What do you mean, why? There’s no chance you’d misunderstand me.”
I tried to suppress my feelings. Kwon Jungwoo was someone who never gave me any room for hope. I had no intention of continuing feelings that could never be mutual. Fortunately, I was quick to give up, so I was glad I realized it before it was too late. So, I tightly hid away my first love, which was also a one-sided love…
But one day, Kwon Jungwoo’s behavior started to become strange.
“Han Jiwon, I’m curious—do even perfectly normal people start acting like they’ve got a screw loose when they’re with you?”
“I’m not sure what you mean….”
“Let me just ask directly. Among your close friends, acquaintances, or even relatives… including same-s*x friends, since we’re being open-minded here.”
His eyes were sharper than usual, but the fingers visible behind them were restless, lightly tapping the steering wheel.
“Has anyone ever told you they felt like they were bewitched by you?”

88751.synopsis:
Jung Yoon-ui, an A-grade guide who was on an elite path due to his exceptional abilities, is demoted after receiving universal condemnation for “that incident.”
[The guide who abandoned an S-class Esper in the field and fled the gate unauthorized.] 
Five years have passed since he became the guide who killed an Esper.
By chance, he ends up guiding a rampaging new S-class Esper, and finds himself the target of the eager advances of this fresh, young talent.
“Officer, can I call you hyung?”
“No.”
“Then how about I just drop the formalities altogether? After all, the law may be strict, but even a 12-year age gap can make us equals…”
Yoon-ui becomes helplessly entangled with the innocent yet assertive Heon-ju.
As he increasingly relies on his kindness, he realizes that he is beginning to depend on him more and more.
But within Yoon-ui’s heart stands a thick wall.
I am the guide who killed an Esper.

94383.synopsis:
On the day the city fell, Feng Yun was offered by her father as a prize to the enemy general. Everyone pitied her fate, believing she would become a captive and fall into a pit of despair.
Yet she tightly covered the small donkey cart she was to leave in, afraid that anyone might see her secret delight. As a child, she acted strangely and spoke shockingly, once foretelling a military disaster so accurately that she was almost burned as a demon by her clan.
Growing up, she was unparalleled in beauty, unmatched across the eight counties of Xuzhou, but was still rejected by her fiancé’s family. In an era of chaos and shattered customs, what path would a female captive take?
“I do not seek a man to grow old with, but rather to live this life as fiercely as I can.” In her past life, Feng Yun had always been wronged and exploited. This time, she vowed to strike first and use her cunning to manipulate those who had wronged her, from the most unattainable nobles to those hiding malicious hearts behind genteel facades.
In others’ eyes, Feng Yun was a mad beauty with a peculiar mind. In her own eyes, she knew everything; perhaps she was even the god of this world.
How they saw her: “She’s so bizarre and fascinating—I can’t help but like her!”
associated_names: The Slender Beauty of Changmen Courtyard

95151.synopsis:
During their second-year sports festival, Nishizaki found himself drawn to Nagano, whose unexpected coolness caught his eye. Intrigued, Nishizaki tried to get Nagano’s attention, but the more his usual tactics failed, the more frustrated—and serious—he became about pursuing him. 
By the time he managed to win Nagano over, Nishizaki’s own interest had waned, and their fleeting romance came to an abrupt end. Yet, their story didn’t end with high school. Years later, fate brings them back together, forcing them to confront old feelings and navigate a complicated dynamic shaped by their changed circumstances.

95407.synopsis:
One day, a bolt of lightning struck Ayeon.
Not only was she set up on a blind date with a man she had never met before, but she was also faced with the prospect of marriage.
If she had known this would happen, she would have dated to her heart’s content!
Ayeon, who had no significant experience in her entire life at the age of twenty-nine, filled with resentment and defiance, did something she shouldn’t have. She crossed the line with her childhood friend Kwon Seong-hyeon, who had been her friend for a long time.
“Is yours? Big?”
“Just now…What did you just say?”
His cool, handsome eyes  noticeably twisted.
“…If it’s big, then what?”
“Can’t I see it just once?”
A rash impulse turned into an immature provocation, and a single moment of recklessness led to uncontrollable consequences…
“Why do you stir up someone who is just minding their own business? You don’t know anything.”
That day, Ayeon realized the timeless rule: A starving beast
should never be poked.

98991.synopsis:
Liang Xusheng, pressured by his mother for years to get married, finally snapped one day. He slammed his hand on the table and declared to his best friend, Lu Xun, “Your mom’s hounding you to get married, my mom’s hounding me to get married. Your mom wants you to find someone from a similar background, my mom wants me to find someone no worse off than our family. Our moms are best friends, and we’re practically childhood sweethearts. Let’s just get married!”
Lu Xun was silent for three seconds. On the fourth, he nodded. “Okay, let’s get married.”
Liang Xusheng thought marrying his bro Lu Xun meant freedom from his mother’s nagging and a blissful continuation of his otaku lifestyle, filled with anime and games. He couldn’t have been more wrong.
Little did he know that the small changes he made to decorate their marital home, perfectly in line with both their tastes, actually hit the bullseye of Lu Xun’s ideal vision of a home.
The few meals he cooked for Lu Xun, waiting for him to come home and eat together, aligned perfectly with Lu Xun’s yearning for married life.
Even his accidentally exposed long, fair legs happened to be exactly Lu Xun’s aesthetic preference.
As a result, while Liang Xusheng remained relatively unfazed by married life, Lu Xun, right under his nose, had fallen head over heels in love.
Liang Xusheng’s view of Lu Xun: My bro.
Lu Xun’s view of Liang Xusheng: Wife, wife, wife.

99247.synopsis:
Due to his aggressive nature, he is the terrifying and stern Northern Duke Dietrich Reinke, whom no one dares to approach easily.
In reality, he’s ‘just’ a cat-person.
No expressions, no words, always looks grumpy?
That’s because he’s a cat.
Extremely hates when plans go wrong?
That’s because he’s a cat.
Obsessed with his territory?
Of course. Cats are territorial animals.
Cats naturally create their own routines and plans,
And get irritated when those aren’t followed.
So this typical Northern Duke is just…
Simply a very ordinary cat.
But only his aide Ruan knows this truth.
People who don’t know mistake the Duke’s very cat-like behavior
For ‘the Northern Duke’s ferocity.’
“Your Grace, please speak in human language.
When you keep expressing yourself in cat language, humans misunderstand because they don’t understand…”
***
“I didn’t become an aide to clean up cat hair! I quit!”
Finally losing patience, Ruan shouted while throwing the lint roller. The Duke, watching Ruan, opened his mouth.
“You.”
Calling Ruan in a deep, solemn voice, the Duke suggested with the same serious expression he wore when executing traitors:
“Would you like… to touch my paw pads?”

99503.synopsis:

101295.synopsis:
Baek Ri Cheong-ra, the true disciple of the Moon Lake Sect, was renowned in the martial arts world for his achievements beyond his age, his neat and beautiful appearance, and his righteous character. However, he harbored a strange and secret desire that others would surely point fingers at if they knew about it.
That desire was to be completely dominated by someone.
However, there was little chance of that desire being fulfilled in reality. Not only did Baek Ri Cheong-ra strongly dislike his beauty being disheveled or appearing vulgar, but his desire also had very demanding conditions (the person had to be clearly stronger than Cheong-ra, never yielding no matter how much resistance he put up, not vulgar but elegant yet with a rough and ruthless side to their personality, not someone who wanted to kill him, and above all, had to be exceptionally good-looking).
Therefore, Cheong-ra thought that he would never be able to realize this desire in reality.
That was until he encountered a man who seemed to be molded exactly to his ideal type.
***
“Did I say I regret it?” Dang Ran-yeong said with a smile on his face, and for a moment, Cheong-ra forgot his anger.
In front of him was the perfect and ideal body of a martial artist. It was a perfect muscular physique that could be called a heavenly gift. Thick pectoral muscles and solid abs were clearly visible beneath. This was because he was only wearing a red silk robe loosely draped over his bare upper body.
Due to the state of his attire, which barely covered his shoulders and back, his muscular upper body was fully exposed. It was an exposure so lazy that it made the onlooker feel embarrassed. Cheong-ra’s eyes wavered.
Noticing Cheong-ra’s gaze, Dang Ran-yeong grinned, revealing his teeth.
“Young Master Baek Ri.”
Then, in the blink of an eye, he slammed Cheong-ra against the wall. The red robe fluttered and settled due to the swift movement that occurred without warning. Cheong-ra couldn’t move an inch because of his arm that was painfully twisted behind his back. As he broke out in a cold sweat, Dang Ran-yeong pressed him even harder against the wall and spoke into his ear.
“I had my suspicions before, but now I know for sure.”
“What is this sudden behavior…!”
Cheong-ra’s mouth, which was about to protest against his arm being twisted even more as if it would be pulled out of his shoulder, closed shut. A groan escaped involuntarily. Dang Ran-yeong’s body, pressing against his back and immobilizing him, was as hard as a rock. Dang Ran-yeong’s hand slipped inside Cheong-ra’s clothes.
“I never thought that behind such a pretty face and noble demeanor, you’d be a pe*verted bastard.”
The grip of his hand was so rough that it felt like the flesh would be torn off.
“No! What nonsense are you spouting!”
Cheong-ra barely managed to struggle with all his might, trying to break free.
Dang Ran-yeong spoke so close that his lips pressed against Cheong-ra’s earlobe. His thick, low-pitched voice resonated in Cheong-ra’s eardrums and invaded deep into his mind. Cheong-ra’s mind turned blank. Due to their excessive proximity, something heavy was pressing against the base of his tailbone.
“Did you think I wouldn’t notice how you look at me longingly every time I beat you up?”

104367.synopsis:
Xiao Yu was humanity’s greatest genius, a scientist whose intellect surpassed all others. He saw the signs of Earth’s impending doom a decade before it happened, warning the world of the catastrophe to come. But instead of being hailed as a savior, he was ridiculed, dismissed as a madman by his peers, and ignored by society.
Realizing that nothing could change humanity’s fate, Xiao Yu made a decision. He turned his brilliance toward survival. Using knowledge decades ahead of human science, he constructed the first true interstellar battleship—not for humanity, but for himself. And when the end came, he did what no one else could. He abandoned his mortal body, fusing his very soul with the ship’s central computer and escaping into the endless void.
Now, drifting through the vast and indifferent cosmos, he is the last remnant of a dead civilization. But he refuses to let humanity vanish without a trace. Why was Earth destroyed? Was it truly unavoidable, or was there something more sinister at play? To uncover the truth, he must push beyond the limits of human science. His battleship is just the beginning. Through relentless technological advancement, he will evolve, forging a warship that can traverse the stars, a fleet that can reclaim humanity’s lost legacy.
The universe is vast, filled with unknown civilizations, ancient mysteries, and dangers beyond imagination. But Xiao Yu will not stop. He will find answers. He will ensure humanity’s flame is not extinguished.
The journey into the unknown begins now.

105903.synopsis:
He entered the academy where only noble children were admitted, hiding the fact that he was the emperor’s illegitimate child.
However, he did not hide his talent.
“We’re friends, right? If you want to continue to be friends, then you haven’t seen anything?”

“Don’t be polite to your friends.”

109487.synopsis:
[Mind reading within the whole family? Cannon fodder? Favorite in the group? A feel-good story? Taking it easy? Entertainment industry? Gossip?]

Later, Huo Jin Ning: [Eh, why has the plot completely changed…]

111023.synopsis:
Wen Jiayue was reborn.
She was reborn back to the day she gave birth to her daughter.
As the daughter of a minor household marrying into the Marquis Manor, she had married above her station. Her husband, Shen Fuhan, was exceptionally handsome and talented, with a smooth path ahead in his official career.
Although he treated people with distance and coldness, and even she, who shared his bed, was no exception, after four years of marriage, Wen Jiayue believed he at least had some feelings for her.
So, even when the Old Madam disliked her for not bearing a grandson, and her husband’s younger sister was arrogant and unreasonable, she endured it all, wholeheartedly serving her husband and managing the entire Marquis Manor meticulously.
She never imagined that Shen Fuhan was actually involved with the Eldest Princess. She and her daughter were tragically poisoned, meeting a miserable end, unable to rest in peace.
Living again, Wen Jiayue stopped serving. She focused wholeheartedly on taking care of her daughter, only wanting to avoid disaster and not repeat her past mistakes.
As for men…
How could a man compare to her daughter?
———
Shen Fuhan kept feeling that his wife had changed recently.
She no longer attended to his daily needs, no longer cared if he was weary, and those smiling almond eyes no longer held any affection for him.
Shen Fuhan paid it no mind. His ambitions lay with the imperial court; he absolutely wouldn’t be hindered by romantic entanglements.
Until, at a flower viewing banquet, he saw Wen Jiayue chatting happily with another man, her gentle face filled with admiration. The talented man and beautiful woman looked like a match made in heaven.
Shen Fuhan watched impassively for a long time. Even as thorns pierced his palm, he felt no pain at all.
associated_names: 娇软夫人摆烂后，清冷权臣揽腰宠

111535.synopsis:
I wanted to have a kind and beautiful little sister like the one of the main character in the novel I was reading.
Only half of my wish was fulfilled.
I was possessed in the novel and had a younger sister.
The problem is that my sister is a psycho villain who killed the protagonist’s parents.

112303.synopsis:
“When the necklace begins to glow blue, you’ll become stronger than anyone.” 
Born as the legitimate heir of the Jin Family Estate, Jin Jahui lived a life of suffering due to a severed meridian. After the death of his parents, he endured endless persecution and cold treatment. The one and only opportunity given to him, eligibility to enter Hyeonmu Academy, was stolen by his cousin, and after relentless bullying, he was pushed off a cliff… That place turned out to be none other than the tomb of the Heavenly Armored War God, the greatest martial artist in history who had once halted the Blood Heaven Order! 
[Molecularly bonded armor equipped.] 
Jin Jahui becomes the one and only successor of the Heavenly Armored War God. Now, as the bearer of armor infused with celestial power, he takes his first step into the Murim world! 
“I’ll crush everything.” 
Jahui’s unrelenting armored path through Murim begins, to stop the Blood Heaven Sect, who seeks to drench the martial world in blood!

112815.synopsis:
It’s been three years after you have been transmigrated into this world.
You overcame language barriers, and through countless efforts, finally passed the Tribunal test and became a government official with insurance and pension.
The humans of this world live in underground cities. Claustrophobia, oxygen deficiency and hunger were not the only things that threatened them — there is also the cultists and daemons of the Dark Gods.
The Tribunal was at the frontline of fighting these Dark God cultists.
It is very dangerous, being a member of the Tribunal. The only solace of the job is for the glory of protecting humankind. You’re not here for glory, though — you’re here for the high salary.
Thankfully, even though your intentions aren’t the purest, you still managed to do a good job. Everyone refer to you as the rising star in the Tribunal — even your superior likes you.
You also admire your superior’s abilities and personality. You think that even outside work, your superior and you are good friends.
Today, he invited you to dinner again, yet you couldn’t work up an appetite.
Because amidst the journey of rising up the ranks in the Tribual — you found out something despairing.
–WHAT?! I’m actually a Dark God?!
———
This is going to be third-person POV, don’t worry.
The superior who feeds (and is also at the frontline of fighting Dark Gods) x The subordinate that got fed (and is also the newest Dark God)
Amidst my numerous anchors, you are still the most shining one.

113327.synopsis:
One of the wealthiest and largest lands on the continent—Trastasa.
This land was ruled by the lord and omnipotent god, Amon, and his partner, Nine.
But unfortunately for the very human Nine, Amon was not a benevolent god.
“My most precious thing.”
“Do not be damaged, do not be marred. You must remain forever beautiful.”
“I would gladly soak you in blood and lick you clean.”
The grand temple that seemed like a perfect paradise on earth,
Yet because of Amon’s cruelty and indifference—as well as the many Leshas who were like his concubines—
Nine found himself burning with frustration every day.
One day, a new Lesha with rare pink hair and eyes arrived,
And this Lesha, Lan Gwen, captured Amon’s attention at first sight—something that had never happened before.
Consumed with jealousy, Nine secretly went to find him…
However, Lan Gwen turned out to be far stranger than Nine had imagined.
“To have received Sha Amon’s attention at the banquet was not my intention, Sha.”
“What…?”
“But may I ask why you came to my chambers, Sha Nine?
If I may be so bold, could it be that you wished to see this servant?”
Tormented all this time by Amon’s coldness,
Nine began to realise that he was strangely affected by the gentle way Lan Gwen treated him.
“For your sake, thousands or tens of thousands of humans are nothing.
You must trample over such things and live, my lovely one.”
“I have no interest in lofty beings like the god of Trastasa.
What I am interested in is the one bound to Sha Amon.”
A beautiful grand temple built atop the desert.
A god both tender and cruel, and a beautiful youth who appeared one day out of nowhere.
The peaceful routine and heart of Nine, which had seemed so stable, begin to split in two…
associated_names: Devoured: The Serpent and the Pomegranate

114095.synopsis:
The noble boy, Elt, was neglected because of his talent for plant magic, which was not suitable for combat. However, one day, Elt remembered that his past life was Japanese. He also noticed that this world was very similar to the game world he had mastered in his past life.
Although his plant magic talent was not recognized by the nobles, it was perfect for developing his territory. Elt received an uninhabited territory and decided to develop it. Combining knowledge from his past life and plant magic, the number of his subjects kept increasing, and Elt rose to become a great noble.
associated_names: Shokubutsu Mahou Cheat de Nonbiri Ryoushu Seikatsu Hajimemasu: Zense no Chishiki o Kushi Shite Nougyou Shitara, Gyakuten Jinsei Hajimatta Ken

115887.synopsis:
Young Mo Yang, his Ancient Divine Clan bloodline sealed, became the target of a scheme and was abandoned by his sect.

Inheriting the mandate of the heavens, he embarks on a path of vengeance that defies fate. If I become a demon, who dares to become a god!

118191.synopsis: Lilith is a pitiful, wandering vampire. Ever since she crossed over into this bizarre and fantastical world, she has lost track of how many years have passed. During all these years, her greatest passion has been helping down-on-their-luck fallen girls… But she never expected that just one simple trip to the hospital to snag a few blood bags to improve her diet would lead to her being captured by a sudden strike team of armed nuns. Poor little vampire…
associated_names: 圣女修道院的吸血姬想要逃离

123823.synopsis:
Everyone knew that the current emperor was cruel and mu*derous. There were three thousand beauties in the harem, but no one dared to even approach him.
Concubines in the harem: Fighting for favor? No way! Our lives are way more important!
The Emperor had been on the throne for five years and still had no offspring. The court officials were all worried. At this time, the foolish granddaughter of Master Shen, Ah Cuo, took the initiative to throw herself into the Emperor’s arms.
The whole court and harem: Shocked!!!
Later, Ah Cuo of the Shen family was promoted again and again. She also got pregnant and finally sat on the throne of the Empress, reaching the peak of her life.
Everyone praised the Empress for her good fortune, but no one knew that the Emperor studied “The Beginner’s Guide to Love”, “The Essential Rules for Good Men”, “The Possibility of Men Getting Pregnant” in the dead of night…

Another version? The witch tries to kill him first, and the soldier sees it coming and hacks her down.

How?! I’m supposed to be a child knight, remember?!

Honestly?
I think everyone here’s got a screw loose.
And you want me to be their mediator?
Yeah, no. They’re both crazy.
